description: SOURCE Seller 'CyrusOne Inc. (:CONE)' names the target as seller. In a public take-private the sellers are CyrusOne's public common stockholders; no controlling holder identified.

SOURCE Buyer lists KKR & Co. Inc. (listed parent) plus Global Infrastructure Management, LLC and Global Infrastructure Partners L.P. Legal acquirer is Cavalry Parent L.P., controlled by funds affiliated with Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P. and Global Infrastructure Management, LLC. Specific fund vehicles not verified. GIP was later acquired by BlackRock (announced Jan 2024).

SOURCE Value $15,238.57m. Party release: 'approximately $15 billion including assumption of debt'. Reuters: $11.49bn equity. Basis of SOURCE figure (EV incl. debt, OP units, fees?) cannot be reconciled without DEFM14A body.
SOURCE record has Announced 2021-11-15 but null Completion Date. Verified: signing 2021-11-14, announcement 2021-11-15, stockholder approval 2022-02-01, completion 2022-03-25.

Source-body access blocked by session egress policy (sec.gov, businesswire.com, kkr.com, cyrusone.com, global-infra.com, web.archive.org, wikipedia.org). Every source was captured as a search-index excerpt. No genuine source body was read.

Not captured: identity of the 2021-08-11 bidder and Parties B/C/I; Board 'Reasons for the Merger'; management projections; debt commitment amounts and leverage; regulatory approvals (HSR/CFIUS/EU FDI) and conditions; post-close REIT status; customer concentration.

Causal grammar permits PR only to 'create' BC. For financial buyers the demand driver (PR-01) acts on the value case (RO/VM), not on a buyer-state deficit. PR-01 is coded Primary but left without a permitted outgoing edge.

Sponsor 'growth-capital platform' thesis (buy a listed developer to fund its pipeline privately) is expressible only as non-terminal BM-23 plus VM-14.1 plus PG-01. No terminal financial-buyer child captures it; R37 passes only conditionally.

Interim-period disposal: CyrusOne agreed (Jan 2022) and closed (~Mar 2022) sale of four Houston data centres to DataBank for $670m between signing and closing. Buyer involvement unknown. Acquired perimeter at close therefore differs from signing perimeter.
Weak sources encountered and excluded: qpcg.ca student deck (26.4x TEV/EBITDA, 'levered buyout'); aggregator snippets on KKR fund size / investment-period start. None used as evidence.
Premium reported as ~25% to unaffected close 2021-09-27 (party) and 5.9% to last close before announcement (Reuters). Not a conflict: different reference dates after 2021-09-28 sale speculation.
